description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Featured' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a class that extends a base controller and includes an index method responsible for generating a view of featured products based on provided settings.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for displaying featured products in the Opencart catalog extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method responsible for gathering featured product data, processing images, prices, and other product details, then returning a view with this data.
